title: Classifying quasi-representations of groups via their characters
summary: For every countable discrete group, we construct a character for finite-dimensional unitary quasi-representations, with values in the inverse limit of the equivariant $K$-theory of its Rips complexes. The character is a complete invariant for quasi-representations up to stable equivalence for amenable groups and, more generally, for groups satisfying the Haagerup property and QR-quasidiagonality. For Haagerup groups satisfying quantitative QR-quasidiagonality, we also obtain a quantiative version of the theorems. These conclusions apply when the maximal group $C^*$-algebra is quasidiagonal…
